properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 13 at 10:11AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor has fallen into Minor Flood Stage, as
upstream heavy rainfall continues to drain through the basin. River
levels are forecast to fall through Minor Flood Stage this week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.0 feet, Water approaches or may enter lowest homes
on or near Wildhog Road and nearby canals. Flooding reaches the
parking lot of the Juno Trail Apartments. Flooding on portions of
Alligator Road and Holiday Road. Lowest lying yards along Blue
Creek are flooded. Roads at Astor Landing Campground and Lake
Dexter Boat Ramp begin to flood. Water enters lower homes closest
to the river on McPherson Lane.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 2.9 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 AM EDT Tuesday was 3.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 2.9 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1100 PM EDT.

days continues.

* WHERE...Gila County in east central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

which will cause flooding of low water crossings

Clear Creek, Cold Water Creek, Chasm Creek, Hardscrabble Creek,
Long Canyon, Fossil Creek, East Verde River, and Verde River.

Plant, Rockin' River Ranch State Park, Cedar Bench Wilderness,
The Toilet Bowl, Fossil Springs Wilderness, Indian Maiden Falls
and West Clear Creek Wilderness.
- This includes the following recreation areas andcampgrounds...
Clear Creek Group Campgrounds.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes and waterfalls on Fossil Creek, Bull Pen Day
Use Area, West Clear Creek near the campground, Fossil Creek Dam
"The Toilet Bowl" and Indian Maiden Falls.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 13 at 1:49PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
Invest 96W is currently rated as "Medium" by the Joint Typhoon
Warning Center, meaning tropical cyclone development is likely, but
beyond 24 hours. It's currently located west of Ujae near 9.3N
164.4E. It continues to slowly organize and strengthen north of
Kosrae/east-northest of Pohnpei.

Inflow into the developing disturbance will allow for locally heavy
rainfall to develop, with over 1 inch per hour rain rates probable
from time to time. Rainfall totals will likely be 2 to 5 inches
tonight through Thursday, with locally higher amounts possible.
Winds will also increase as 96W strengthens, and at least isolated
wind gusts to 30 knots are possible with any heavy shower or
thunderstorm that develops.

Gusty winds and elevated, choppy seas will make marine conditions
difficult. Residents may need to reconsider plans for inter-island
boating as the week continues. Also keep up to date with the latest
information from your local emergency management agency.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 12 at 1:30PM MDT by NWS Riverton WY
properties.description:
Rounds of precipitation are expected to move across portions of WY
starting Monday afternoon through Tuesday evening. Colder
temperatures should support wet snowfall across the higher
elevations mainly above 9,000 ft.

* WHAT...Periods of light to moderate wet snowfall with total
snow accumulations of a coating to 3 inches. The highest
elevations above 10,000 ft may see accumulations of 3 to 6
inches.

* WHERE...Elevations mainly above 9,000 ft across the Teton, Gros
Ventre, and Absaroka Ranges.

* WHEN...Monday afternoon through Tuesday evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Travel may be difficult in the backcountry
and especially at higher elevations. Plan accordingly if headed
into the backcountry for any outdoor activities.

For graphical depictions of the snowfall forecast, including the
official NWS forecast, high end amounts, and low end amounts, visit
https://weather.gov/riw/winter.

properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 12 at 10:48AM MDT until October 13 at 9:00AM MDT by NWS Pocatello ID
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 29 expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Magic Valley, Shoshone/Lava Beds, Arco/Mud Lake
Desert, and Lower Snake River Plain.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 9 AM MDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Extensive cloud cover will be a limiting
factor, likely making sub-freezing temperatures very short-lived.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
